arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error')
    for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw, fields.String):
        f = cls(load_default='load', dump_default='dump')
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == 'load'
        assert f.serialize('value', {}) == 'dump'
        assert f.deserialize('value') == 'value'
        assert f.serialize('value', {'value': 'value'}) == 'value'
        assert not f.metadata
        f.load_default, f.dump_default = 'new load', 'new dump'
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == 'new load'
        assert f.serialize('value', {}) == 'new dump'
        f = cls(load_default=list, dump_default=lambda: 'callable')
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == []
        assert f.deserialize(missing) is not f.deserialize(missing)
        assert f.serialize('value', {}) == 'callable'
        assert cls(load_default=None).deserialize(None) is None
        assert cls().deserialize(missing) is missing
        assert cls().serialize('value', {}) is missing
        try:
            cls(load_default=0, required=True)
        except ValueError as e:
            assert 'load_default' in str(e)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Required fields cannot have a load default')

    class Child(Schema):
        name = fields.String()

    class Parent(Schema):
        child = fields.Nested(Child, load_default=lambda: {'name': 'load'}, dump_default={'name': 'dump'})
        text = fields.String(load_default='load text', dump_default='dump text')
        constant = fields.Constant('fixed', load_default='ignored', dump_default='ignored')
        dynamic = fields.String(dump_default=lambda: 'dynamic')

    assert Parent().load({}) == {'child': {'name': 'load'}, 'text': 'load text', 'constant': 'fixed'}
    assert Parent().dump({}) == {'child': {'name': 'dump'}, 'text': 'dump text', 'constant': 'fixed', 'dynamic': 'dynamic'}
    props = JSONSchema().dump(Parent())['definitions']['Parent']['properties']
    assert props['child']['default'] == {'name': 'dump'}
    assert props['text']['default'] == 'dump text'
    assert props['constant']['default'] == 'fixed'
    assert 'default' not in props['dynamic']
    constant = fields.Constant('fixed', load_default='ignored', dump_default='ignored')
    assert constant.load_default == constant.dump_default == 'fixed'
    assert constant.deserialize(missing) == 'fixed'
    assert constant.deserialize('other') == 'fixed'
    assert constant.serialize('value', {'value': 'other'}) == 'fixed'

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    f = fields.Raw(default=1, missing=2, dump_default=3, load_default=4)
    assert (f.dump_default, f.load_default) == (3, 4)
    assert (f.default, f.missing) == (3, 4)
    f.default, f.missing = 5, 6
    assert (f.dump_default, f.load_default) == (5, 6)
    assert len(caught) == 6
print('New API, compatibility aliases, and warning-free schema generation checks passed.')
PY
